title: Composable banking becomes default architecture for new core launches
text: By 2026 nearly 60% of new core banking implementations will use a composable, API-first architecture, per Gartner. The trend strengthens demand for capability-mapped vendor selection (cap_id-aware procurement) and reusable Digital Strategy Document (P1C1.1.1) templates. Wealth management and asset manager segments are following suit.

title: Regulatory Change Management tooling consolidates around 5 vendors
text: Celent's 2026 vendor map shows Regulatory Change Management (P1C2.7.1) consolidating around five major platforms, with mid-tier banks favoring AI-assisted impact analyzers. Cost-to-comply has dropped 18% YoY among adopters.
